text:
Do you ask me, painter, how I wish

you to paint the gaze and beauty

of those eyes where Eden shines,

of those eyes for which I live and die?

Copy the radiance of the morning star,

the sweetness of a gentle gazelle,

the tenderness of the loving turtle-dove,

the shine of the flattering diamond.

You must paint them large and alive

where the blessed torch may shine

of noble meditation, very expressive,

With sweet undefined vagueness;

do you want to give them still more charms

of passionate love? give them life.

translation.title: The Eyes of ...
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the painterly instruction while keeping the formal address.
